mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 69 degrees. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and you should definitely look up tonight at 9:35 PM to catch the International Space Station traveling from the West Northwest over Cross Plains to the Southeast near Oregon.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for all Verona Area School District students. Designs must be original, include the text I Voted, and be submitted by July 22 for a chance to be featured in the November election. Also, the city continues to provide transparency through the VHAT cable channel and online meeting recordings.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy live music at Concerts in the Park, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding local activity, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver had become stuck on a large rock. The 36-year-old individual was ultimately arrested for an O-W-I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Really Reese's. Culver's is currently closed, but they open their doors at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Volcano.
